starting_state.independent_review: Sol Medium independently reviewed the raw target, indirect table entry, callback path, neighboring D0 consumers, and unknowns; the signed-SLTI bounds caveat was checked against the original dispatcher instructions.

original_mips_evidence.raw_validation: Parsed all 55 target instruction words from the pinned assembly's ROM/VMA comments. The exact 0xDC-byte slice matches both SHA-verified ROM images.
original_mips_evidence.frame_and_entry: Subtracts 0x38 from sp and saves ra plus s0-s6. It reads no incoming argument. One verified indirect entry is command-table index 5; the inferred caller-facing signature is void(void) because the dispatcher reloads its queue count into v0 after the jalr call.
original_mips_evidence.indirect_dispatch: func_80038938_39538 calls func_80038F68_39B68 when D_801C09C9 is zero. The dispatcher takes the queued word's low halfword and uses D_8006E5CC at ROM 0x6F1CC; raw entry 5 at 0x6F1E0 equals 0x80039F84 in both images. Its bounds use signed slti: values 0-15 index the corresponding entries; values 0x8000-0xFFFF also compare negative and reach the table-address calculation without an unsigned range guard. No normal-play occurrence of such values is claimed.
field_contract: lbu D_801C09D0; zero returns without a target-owned write or call.
For nonzero D0, sb zero clears the byte once before a fixed 16-entry scan.
Entry records start at 0x801C0C28 with stride 0xB0. Each iteration first stores the current pointer to D_801C1728, then lw reads the full 32-bit word at entry+0.
A zero word skips active-entry work; a nonzero word loads the byte at +6, ORs bit 0, and stores it back, preserving other bits.
For active entries, lhu reads +0x58 and the function passes (value >> 8) & 0x7F as ALPan. It reloads the word at D_8007A230 into a0 and calls alSynSetPan with target 0x801C0A68 + index*0x1C in a1.
The D_801C1728 slot ends at entry 15. D0 is not read or cleared again, so a callback-written value survives this function.
related_state: func_8003889C_3949C clears D_801C09CE, D_801C09CF, and D_801C09D0, then registers func_80038938_39538 through alSynAddPlayer.
Matched funcs 80039F3C and 80039F60 use D_801C09CF as a byte gate and conditionally write signed byte D_801C09CE; 80039F84 does not access CE or CF.
func_8003A060_3AC60 returns if D0 is nonzero; otherwise sets it to 1 and pans active entries to constant 0x40.
func_8003BCFC_3C8FC uses fixed pan 0x40 when D0 is nonzero and otherwise reads the current entry's +0x58 value.
unknown: The semantic name and runtime trigger for D_801C09D0 are not established. func_8003A060_3AC60 statically sets it and func_8003889C_3949C clears it; the live event that reaches those writes is unknown.
No live-game capture establishes the audible outcome or normal runtime values of the queued command halfword.
The source-level declaration and exact C types of the entry and pan-target records are not recovered; the documented widths/strides are instruction-derived.

host_reference.coverage: Zero latch is a no-op; nonzero latch clears once; all-empty and active records; active indices 0, 5, 10 and 15; high-bit-only nonzero object word; pan inputs 0000, 7F00, 8000 and FF00; flag OR preserving other bits; callback order and arguments; pointer slot written for each of 16 entries; CE/CF/D1 sentinels; synthetic callback re-arming D0; existing 3A1E8 reset fixture.
